# mori skills

> Skills for agents that use mori. Each skill is one directory, `<name>/SKILL.md`, with a `name`
> and a `description` in its frontmatter; this file indexes them. The layout works with any agent
> or tool that reads a skills directory or an llms.txt index, and people can add their own skills
> for their own workflows beside these.

## Skills

- [using-mori](using-mori/SKILL.md): the commands, JSON output, errors and the rules agents follow when using mori
- [lead-tree](lead-tree/SKILL.md): how to run a long-lived coordinating tree where several agents' work comes together
